title: Sell hotel only when no mortgage path covers debt
description: Sell hotel only when no mortgage path covers debt. Debt is large enough that hotel sale is necessary despite releasing house supply. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.private_thought: Debt is large enough that hotel sale is necessary despite releasing house supply. liquidation mortgage sell bankruptcy preserve

breakdown.message: Chooses sell_houses_or_hotel for this liquidation state.
Sells buildings only after non-core mortgages cannot cover the debt.
Private thought names the liquidation tradeoff.
